methodology: Individual sense review and model-assisted editorial judgment of native Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Arabic forms. Explicit estimates for the specified concept and language only; no English CEFR labels, HSK/JLPT/TOPIK conversion, rank thresholds, or quota filling. English source meanings identify senses and do not supply levels. C2 is reserved here for specialized academic or uncommon technical senses; transparent or more established advanced native terms are placed at C1. Different languages may therefore have different or absent assignments. These judgments are not official or independently native-speaker validated. A small reviewed sample supplements the multi-factor rubric; no claim is made that all advanced words are covered.
